name: Neo 3.0
tagline: Autonomous agents coordinating safely before conflicts emerge
description: Neo is the agent coordination layer that prevents merge conflicts before code is written, enabling AI agents and developers to work simultaneously on shared codebases without wasted tokens or manual conflict resolution.

hero.problem: Multiple agents writing to the same codebase causes merge conflicts, failed builds, and wasted tokens
hero.solution: Neo detects resource conflicts at the intent stage—before code generation—enabling safe parallel agent work
hero.hook: Intent → Coordinate → Authorize → Generate → Commit (zero manual merges)

features.title: Pre-Generation Conflict Detection
features.description: Agents check for conflicts before generating code, not after

features.title: Line & Function-Level Analysis
features.description: Detects overlaps at semantic boundaries, not just file-level

features.title: Smart Checkpointing
features.description: Agents pause without polling, context fully preserved and resumable
features.metric: Zero token waste on conflict resolution

features.title: Multi-Agent Safe Coordination
features.description: Supports unlimited concurrent agents with per-resource locking

features.title: Zero Dependencies
features.description: Runs on Python 3.8+ with no external packages

features.title: Real-Time MCP Integration
features.description: Streams conflict notifications to Claude Code, Devin, and OpenAI IDEs

use_cases: Multiple AI agents autonomously coding the same repository
Distributed developer teams working on interdependent files
Enterprise deployments requiring audit trails and conflict prevention
CI/CD pipelines with autonomous code generation and review
highlights: Multi-tenant architecture supporting 1500+ ops/sec per tenant
5 phases of agent autonomy: event model, handoff, context, provenance, policy
State Machine v2 with unlimited developer scalability
